rules: Supplier products are auxiliary evidence only and never canonical products.
Image SHA-256 is evidence only and never product identity.
Fuzzy matching can generate candidates later but cannot auto-assign product_id.
NEW_PRODUCT is a reconciliation recommendation, not permission to insert.
CONFLICT and REVIEW_REQUIRED always require human review.
No product, brand, category, image or Storage write is performed in FASE 1.19.
